design.title: Design system
design.subtitle: A calm, readable identity for desktop work, still comfortable on a phone.
design.principles: One navy, one gold signal, plenty of air. Hierarchy comes from type and spacing, not from extra chrome.

lead.colors: Navy carries the product. Gold marks a single point of attention.
lead.type: A short scale. Titles stay quiet, numbers stay tabular.
lead.space: A 4 px scale. Sections breathe, controls stay compact.
lead.buttons: One primary action per surface. The rest stay in the background.
lead.inputs: Labels sit above the field. Errors sit directly underneath.
lead.tables: A sticky header, quiet rows, amounts aligned to the right.
lead.cards: A border and a light shadow. One idea per card.
lead.badges: Status only. A dot when the word needs a faster read.
lead.dropdowns: A short menu. Destructive actions stay last.
lead.modals: A decision or a short form. The page stays behind.
lead.drawers: Detail that should not replace the list.
lead.tabs: A few peers. The active tab is a navy underline.
lead.alerts: Inline context that stays until it is resolved.
lead.toasts: A brief confirmation that leaves on its own.
lead.charts: Navy bars and lines. Gold marks the latest point.
lead.empty: Say what is missing, then offer the next step.
lead.loading: A spinner when the wait is short and the shape is unknown.
lead.skeletons: A skeleton when the layout is already known.
